item.title: Consistency pays well but A.I. doesn't ?
item.description: Good morning! It feels nice to get back into writing after a while—and what better topic to explore than the art of writing itself? Last week, while reading through a newsletter as part of my Sunday morning ritual, I found myself wondering - What would potentially be the motivation factor behind consistently writing a newsletter besides making it a lucrative billboard for ad publishers? It’s safe to say that curiosity took the better part of my weekend researching into popular newsletters and some research surrounding the topic.
